names: Cumulative post-breakdown carbon inventory from gas injection, expressed as six equivalent-electron counts for every injected neutral carbon atom.
Cumulative deuterated methane (CD4) delivered by gas injection after plasma breakdown, expressed as an equivalent-electron count with ten count units per neutral molecule.
Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of deuterium delivered by gas injection after plasma breakdown.
Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of helium-3 atoms delivered by gas injection after plasma breakdown, assigning two count units to each atom.
Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of helium-3 atoms introduced by gas injection during plasma prefill before plasma breakdown, with two count units assigned per atom.
Cumulative post-breakdown equivalent-electron inventory of neutral hydrogen delivered by gas injection, with one count unit assigned to each hydrogen atom.
Cumulative post-breakdown lithium inventory delivered by gas injection, expressed as three equivalent-electron counts per injected lithium atom.
Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of lithium introduced by gas injection during plasma prefill, assigning three count units to each lithium atom.
Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of carbon-13-labeled methane delivered by gas injection after plasma breakdown, with ten count units assigned to each neutral 13CH4 molecule.
Cumulative post-breakdown nitrogen inventory delivered by gas injection, expressed as seven equivalent-electron counts for each injected nitrogen atom.
Cumulative oxygen gas introduced during the prefill phase by gas injection, expressed as an equivalent-electron count where each oxygen atom contributes 8 count units equal to its atomic number.
Cumulative number of particles released by ablation from an injected pellet up to a specified position along its trajectory.
Cumulative post-breakdown propane inventory delivered by gas injection, expressed as 26 equivalent electrons for each neutral molecule.
Cumulative post-breakdown inventory of silane molecules delivered by gas injection, expressed as an equivalent-electron count with 18 equivalent electrons per neutral SiH4 molecule.

Accumulated total gas count at midplane due to gas injection is the cumulative unweighted count of neutral gas particles introduced by all injection valves near the equatorial midplane over the specified accumulation interval. It sums all injected species and is not weighted by neutral electron count, atomic number, mass, or valve identity.
Cumulative number of tritium atoms delivered by gas injection since plasma breakdown, expressed as an equivalent-electron count where each tritium atom corresponds to one equivalent electron.
Cumulative post-breakdown xenon inventory delivered by gas injection, expressed as an equivalent-electron count with 54 count units assigned to each xenon atom.
Geometric area of the designated diagnostic aperture surface that admits or collects radiation or particles.

Boundary-averaged number density of argon ions on the plasma boundary, represented by the last closed flux surface separating the magnetically confined plasma from the open-field-line scrape-off layer. Unless a charge state is specified separately, argon ions refers to all ionization stages combined.
Charge-state-summed number density of argon ions, excluding neutral argon, evaluated locally on the magnetic separatrix.
Number density of beryllium ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all ionization states.
Timestamp at which plasma breakdown begins and discharge current starts to flow.
Number density of carbon impurity ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all ionization states.
Average length of open magnetic field lines during plasma initiation, set to 1 when field lines become closed
Net electron particle production rate accumulated over the volume enclosed by a specified magnetic flux surface, contributing to the electron density balance.
Geometric rate at which the cumulative volume enclosed by a nested magnetic flux surface changes with its dimensionful toroidal-flux coordinate.
Number density of deuterium ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over all ionic charge states, and excluding neutral deuterium.

Number density of the effective deuterium-tritium fuel pseudo-species at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local, intensive particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface.
Flux-surface-averaged number density of deuterium-tritium pseudo-species ions at the plasma boundary (separatrix).
Local net electron particle production rate per volume, including both creation and removal terms in the electron continuity equation.
Electrostatic interaction energy per positive test charge at the wall, relative to a chosen electrical reference.
Dimensionless contribution to turbulent energy transport carried across magnetic flux surfaces by the E×B drift associated with a perturbed electrostatic potential.

Normalized energy flux due to perturbed parallel magnetic field is the signed normalized contribution of compressional magnetic-field fluctuations parallel to the equilibrium magnetic field to flux-surface-normal turbulent energy transport. For a linear eigenmode, it is the corresponding rotating-frame weight for that energy-flux contribution.
Dimensionless electromagnetic contribution of perturbed parallel vector-potential fluctuations to turbulent energy transport across magnetic flux surfaces.
Full end-to-end physical size of a soft X-ray detector along the applicable horizontal or vertical detector-plane direction.
Unit direction vector defining the first measurement direction associated with an elliptic shatter cone in the right-handed Cartesian (x, y, z) frame.
Number density of argon ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over all argon ion charge states and excluding neutral argon.
Number density of beryllium ions averaged over the plasma boundary, summed over all ionization states and excluding neutral beryllium.
Number density of carbon ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface at the plasma boundary, summed over all carbon ion charge states and excluding neutral carbon.
Number density of deuterium ions averaged over the plasma-boundary flux surface, summed over all deuterium ion charge states and excluding neutral deuterium.
Flux-surface-averaged number density of deuterium-tritium pseudo-species ions at the plasma boundary (separatrix).
Flux-surface-averaged electron number density at the plasma boundary, using inverse-magnitude poloidal-flux-gradient weighting rather than a pointwise value.
Number density of helium-3 ions averaged over the plasma boundary, summed over all helium-3 ion charge states and excluding neutral helium-3.
Number density of helium-4 ions averaged over the full plasma-boundary flux surface, summed over all ionic charge states and excluding neutral helium-4.
Number density of hydrogen ions averaged over the plasma-boundary flux surface, with all hydrogen ion charge states summed and neutral hydrogen excluded.
Flux-surface average of reciprocal major radius, providing a geometric equilibrium coefficient for toroidal geometry in flux-coordinate equations.
Number density of iron ions averaged over the plasma-boundary flux surface, summed over all iron ion charge states and excluding neutral iron.
Number density of lithium ions averaged over the plasma-boundary flux surface, summed over all lithium ion charge states and excluding neutral lithium.
Number density of neon ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface, with all neon ion charge states summed and neutral neon excluded.
Number density of nitrogen ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface bounding the confined plasma, summed over all ion charge states and excluding neutral nitrogen.
Dimensionless toroidal-flux surface label evaluated on the last closed magnetic surface, serving as the outer reference for the normalized flux coordinate.
Number density of oxygen ions flux-surface-averaged at the plasma boundary, summed over all charged oxygen ionization states and excluding neutral oxygen.
Geometry-weighted flux-surface average of the net conventional toroidal current density driving the equilibrium poloidal magnetic-flux distribution.
Flux-surface-averaged number density of all charged ion species at the plasma boundary, summed over charge states and excluding neutral particles.
Number density of tritium ions averaged over the plasma boundary, summed over all tritium ion charge states and excluding neutral tritium.
Flux-surface-averaged number density of positively charged tungsten ions on the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over all ionization states.
Number density of xenon ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over all xenon ion charge states and excluding neutral xenon.
Flux-surface average of the squared flux-surface-normal gradient of the toroidal flux radius.
Minimum Euclidean clearance between the plasma separatrix and the nearest limiter or wall element at the closest-wall point.
Gap at the outboard midplane is the major-radius separation between the inner and outer separatrices in a double-null or near-double-null equilibrium.
Number density of helium-3 ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over charge states.
Number density of helium-4 ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all charge states.
Number density of hydrogen ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all hydrogen ion charge states.
Physical extent of a poloidal magnetic-field probe coil measured along its assigned local normal sensing axis, contributing to the coil’s magnetic-flux response.

Physical length of a toroidal magnetic-field probe is the non-negative axial extent of the probe coil along its local normal sensing axis. It characterizes sensor geometry and effective sensing volume; magnetic-flux sensitivity is associated with enclosed coil area and winding turn count rather than this length alone.
Number density of lithium ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all ionization states.
Number density of neon ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all ionization stages.

Radial flux-surface location of the selected plasma boundary, expressed by the normalized poloidal flux coordinate. It is the linear normalized poloidal flux value, increasing from zero at the magnetic axis to one at the separatrix, of the closed flux surface taken as the plasma boundary; fixed-boundary equilibrium calculations commonly set it slightly below one to select a surface just inside the separatrix.

Gyro-Bohm-normalized radial gyrocenter energy flux at a flux surface, with radial meaning the R component in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, due to perturbed parallel vector-potential fluctuations.
Dimensionless toroidal-flux surface label evaluated on the last closed magnetic surface, serving as the outer reference for the normalized flux coordinate.
Dimensionless toroidal-flux surface label at the magnetic separatrix, identifying the outermost closed magnetic surface and its outer normalization value.
Flux-surface-averaged field-aligned conventional plasma current density generated non-inductively by electromagnetic-wave–particle interactions.
Normalized particle flux driven by electrostatic potential (E×B drift)

Normalized turbulent particle flux due to the perturbed parallel magnetic field is the contribution of parallel magnetic-field fluctuations to particle transport across magnetic flux surfaces. In a linear eigenmode decomposition, it is the corresponding rotating-frame weight when that reference frame is used.
Peak amplitude of the radio-frequency current flowing through an antenna strap.
Time instant at which plasma breakdown begins, measured from the pulse time origin.
Poloidal component of the effective velocity convecting energy for one ion charge state along the poloidal direction of flux coordinates (ρ, θ, φ).
Poloidal advective energy-transport velocity for a specified ion charge state.

Major-radius coordinate of a magnetic flux surface at the outboard midplane, locating its position relative to the toroidal symmetry axis. The value at magnetic-axis height coincides with the surface's maximum-major-radius location only for an up-down-symmetric equilibrium.
Major-radius coordinate of a specified geometric point associated with a line of sight, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

Radial ion charge-state momentum flux is the flux-surface-normal transport rate per unit area of radial linear momentum carried by ions in one specified ionization state. Radial momentum is the major-radius component in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame; positive flux is outward across magnetic flux surfaces toward the last closed flux surface.
Radial component of momentum flux of ions, summed over charge states.

Radial ion momentum flux over the edge region is the R-direction component of ion momentum flux in the edge plasma in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, summed over all ion species and charge states.

Radial ion momentum source is the net force-per-area source for the total ion population, summed over charge states and projected toward increasing major radius in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.
Effective radial convection velocity (pinch velocity) for ion charge state energy transport on GGD grid subsets.
Radial component of total momentum flux in the edge plasma.

Rate of transport of radial linear momentum per unit area across an oriented surface in the plasma, combining convective, isotropic-pressure, and viscous or turbulent-stress contributions, with radial defined along increasing major radius in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.
Radial component of the momentum source term (force density) on the GGD mesh
Major-radius component of the net area-normalized momentum transfer to neutral particles occupying one specified internal quantum state.
Radial component of momentum flux of neutral species, summed over internal states.

Radial neutral momentum flux is the radial-radial component of neutral linear-momentum transport in the edge plasma, combining convective and isotropic-pressure contributions summed over all neutral species and internal states.
Effective non-negative magnitude of the radio-frequency current oscillating along a single ion-cyclotron-heating antenna strap.
Wavelength-coordinate factor scaling a spectrometer-channel instrument function to detector count rate.
Response-weighted optical phase-space acceptance of a spectrometer channel, combining collecting area and accepted ray directions across its wavelength response.
Toroidal angle (φ) coordinate of a position along the pellet path, measured in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.
Toroidal angular coordinate locating a measurement position around the machine symmetry axis in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.
Toroidal angle coordinate of a wave beam position along its propagation path
Toroidal-angle coordinate of the geometric center of an electron-cyclotron launcher mirror in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.
Toroidal angular coordinate of the first reference point on a diagnostic line of sight, locating that point around the machine symmetry axis.
Overall horizontal and vertical physical size of the X-ray crystal spectrometer camera body.
Separatrix-averaged number density of ionized tungsten at the plasma boundary, summed over charge states W1+ through W74+. Neutral tungsten atoms are excluded.
Tungsten-ion number density on the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over all positive ionization states and distinguished from its flux-surface average.
Signed vertical coordinate of the camera's geometric center, measured along Z in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.
Vertical ion charge-state momentum flux is the flux-surface-normal transport rate per unit area of vertical linear momentum carried by ions in one specified ionization state.

Vertical ion charge-state momentum source is the vertical projection of the area-normalized momentum source acting on one specified ion charge state. It represents directional momentum transfer to or from that charge state resolved along the height axis Z in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.
Peak magnitude of the radio-frequency current at a specified position along an ion-cyclotron-heating antenna strap.
Cartesian x-component of the unit vector directed along the major geometric axis of the elliptic shatter cone.
Number density of xenon ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all ionization stages.
Signed Z-direction cosine of a camera’s viewing-direction unit vector in the right-handed Cartesian (x, y, z) frame.
